How much does it cost to run a treadmill?

A typical treadmill uses about 1,500 watts (600–3,000W depending on the model). Used for 30 minutes per use, 3 uses a week, it costs about 12p per use and £18.48 a year at the current price cap rate.

Cost per use
12p
About £18.48 a year at 30 minutes per use, 3 uses a week.

Standing charge not included.

Ways to cut the cost

  • Check the power rating on the plug or label for the most accurate figure.
  • A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what a device uses.
  • Turn things off at the wall when not in use.

Questions

How much does it cost to run a treadmill per hour?

At 26.32p/kWh, a 1500W model costs about 24p an hour, allowing for it running at full power about 60% of the time.

How much does it cost to run a treadmill per year?

About £18.48 a year, based on 30 minutes per use, 3 uses a week. Change the sliders above to match how you use yours.

Is the standing charge included?

No. You pay the standing charge every day whether or not the appliance is used, so it isn't part of the cost of running it.

How do I find my treadmill's actual power use?

Check the rating label, plug or manual for the wattage, or the energy label for kWh figures. A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what it uses.
